panels.description: State of all 12 physical links over time. Green=UP, Red=DOWN. Uses min() of both endpoints — a link shows DOWN if either interface reports 0. Port-qualified labels identify the exact interface pair per link. Topology changes require updating the pairs in this query.

panels.title: Physical Link State

panels.description: State of all 12 ISIS adjacency pairs over time. Green=UP, Red=DOWN. Uses static topology pairs with or vector(0) fallback: XR removes a neighbor from its YANG table when the adjacency drops (no DOWN state is emitted), so the fallback ensures rows remain visible as DOWN rather than disappearing. Topology changes require updating the pairs in this query — see ADR-001.

targets.expr:
